author: Huawei
description:
#Huawei unveiled its NG WAN architecture at #MWC26 in Barcelona, designed to upgrade IP bearer networks with a focus on security and resilience, multi-dimensional awareness, and network autonomy, supporting new growth for carriers in the Internet of Agents era. 

Huawei exhibited a series of innovations including the NetEngine 8000 Series Router, positioned around building AI-centric IP networks and boosting new growth for carriers, along with intrinsic security boards and quantum-secure solutions. 

Together, these technologies help carriers strengthen security, improve experience assurance, and enable intelligent connectivity. Read more from MWC Barcelona 2026: https://bit.ly/40GXgMG
title: Huawei Launches NG WAN Powered by NetEngine 8000 Series Router at MWC

author: Huawei
description:
Around the world, millions still live without reliable connectivity. But connection is more than a signal. It means access to education, healthcare, and economic opportunity.
 
#Huawei works with partners across countries and regions to bridge the digital divide. By deploying connectivity in remote rural areas and enabling small businesses with digital tools, technology is helping communities move forward.
 
Students join online classrooms. Entrepreneurs expand their businesses beyond their local towns. Families gain access to essential services.
 
This is #TECHcares in action. By connecting the unconnected, we are not only expanding networks. We are unlocking potential and building a more inclusive digital future for all.
 
Discover how technology is turning connection into opportunity at the TECH Cares Forum happening at #MWC26 Barcelona: https://bit.ly/4rV8xF2
title: Connecting the Unconnected, Empowering Every Community
